newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs little changed, profit-taking limits upside.
newsitem.headline: JGBs little changed, profit-taking limits upside.

text.p: The key September 10-year Japanese government bond futures contract was little changed after paring initial gains by mid-morning trade on Monday.
JGBs rose initially due to weak share prices, a rise in the yen versus the dollar and firmness of cash bonds, but profit-taking set in and later dragged them down, traders said.
The September stood at 124.98 as of 0102 GMT, down slightly from Friday's close of 125.01. It had risen as high as 125.18 early in the morning.
The benchmark 182nd JGB yield stood at 2.265 percent, up slightly from Friday's close of 2.260 percent.
